text: Letter dated May 22, 1972, from Budget Director, Kansas Department of Administration with attached comments from t'e State Park and Pesources Authority and from the Director, Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission. The proposed legislation contributes to the objectives of the State Recreation Plan and does not conflict with any activities of the Kansas Park and Resources Authority. It was felt by the Director, Forestry, Fish and Game Commission that the proposal is negative and that emphasis is placed on protection rather than wise management. An objection was noted to Federal assumption of State authority for endangered species. This first comment deals with the proposed legislation rather than the draft Environmental Statement. We agree that management of the species is important. Protection is but one of a number of forms of management that are needed. Purpose of legislation is to provide the legal authority for the forms of management that is required to restore endangered species. We believe that HR 4758 embodies all the authority needed to carry out any form of management needed, including protection. For our comment on Federal assumption authority please refer to our reply to similar objections by the State of Indiana.
